content: Pɔl bàmutɔm Lɔmà
Mpal bàtsül mbar naa bi iwal an'swà mukyà Itali, ba bàpɛ Pɔl anà baar a bɔlokà amwɛy akà kaptɛn mwɛy ikɔb ande Zülyüs, umwɛy uboo a itsuŋ a Lɔmà bàfàbel naa Itsuŋ a Sɛzar.
Bi kàbilà kà an'swà a Adalamit màyilyaaŋà à kun'kɔɔl a Azi, waa kàkyen. Un'nsi Masɛdwan a Tɛsalɔnikà mwɛy ikɔb ande Aristark kàkäl anà bi.
Taaŋtyà, bi kàmbär u Sidɔn. Zülyüs kàwɛlà Pɔl unsà ubwaŋ banswà, nde kun'pɛɛ mbwo mukàler asam ande ban'kwo mukun'bay.
Kan'lwomà bi apan, bi kàläb kà an'dà, kàlyaaŋ kà un'kɔɔl a Shipɛlɛ ntɔn un'pöb kiyeelà lisà.
Apan bi kàbwel ngyäl a kölàköl tsütsü a Silisi anà Pamfili, waa kàtɔlà u Mira a Lisi.
Akun, kaptɛn kàmɛn an'swà a Alɛksandri màmukyà Itali, laa kibiil nde.
Bi kàkyer ilä mbɔɔn ntɔn an'swà màyikyeenà ikye ikye, a mpay yanswà bi, kàkàtöl bi tsütsü a Snide. Ntɔn un'pöb kàyee wa lisà, bi kàlyaaŋ u ngyɛl a isaŋ a Krɛte, tsütsü a Salmɔnɛ.
Bi kya kàlyaaŋ a mpay yanswà tii kàkàtol bi kà ikal mwɛy bàfàbel Bo Pɔr, tsütsü a bul làmwɛy ikɔb a la Lasàyà.
Taaŋ làmwɛy làbwɛlàbwɛl làlyaaŋ, nkyeen udu a an'dà yàbulà yà bɔɔmà, ntɔn ilä a ukin udyà a Ayudà kyàkäl aŋàlyaaŋ itaan, Pɔl waa kakyään,
kàtɛn naa: « Asam amɛ, mɛ in'manà naa nkyeen udu a an'dà itwaal ube mbɔɔn, indiir mbɔɔn ikyà bwà, kànà isaa anà an'swà mpɛl anki, wɛɛ anà mɔ̈ɔ̈ a baar abi sye. »
Wɛɛ mfum a nsaab a Lɔmà mpem ande kàpɛ akà kaptɛn a an'swà anà akà ŋan'swà, akwànaa akà ndaa a Pɔl.

Yumwɛy ayi: làbuŋ alà làkwe anki naa baar bàkäl paa u paŋà a mpye. Lalan baar mbɔɔn bàkäl ba an'kyän mwɛy naa ba bàläb mbwo aba anà muleŋ mukɔlà Fɛniksi, làbuŋ làmwɛy là Krɛt bàduub mper làfàminà taaŋ ntɔn isà ilyaaŋ kwo.
Un'pöb a ngwal udu a ngyäl a kölàköl
Kipöb kyàfü ngyɛl, waa kyàlyaaŋà, apan ba bàsii naa ma màkäl an'kyän aŋàbwaŋ, ba bàtsuuŋ an'swà, bàsɛmà muyikyà ukɔl a isaŋ a Krɛt.
Wɛɛ ungö a kitaaŋ, un'pöb a ngwal awà bàfàbel naa Örakilɔ­n, kàfü isaŋ akin, waa kàyabweel,
kàsyen an'swà, ma màkwe anki munwaan a un'pöb, laa kàwɛy bi naa wa kisyen.
Bi kàlyaaŋ u ngyɛl a kisaŋ bàfàbel Kɔda, bi kàböŋ a mpay muwal itiir a un'sɛŋ.
Ungö mufuur kya uboo, unsà bɔɔmà mukàböl kà anseŋ a Sirt, ba bàbäm an'swà in'siŋ asànaa nkwɛl, waa bàtɔɔm löŋ. Ba bàläb muyiwɔŋ abun.
Un'pöb a ngwal kàkäl mukàyisiinà a ngwal, lalan taaŋtyà bàtɔɔm ba indiir kan'dà.
Kà ilä kyàtär, ba bàtɔɔmà anà an'kɔɔ aba ŋakwo indiir a isal a an'swà.
Ilä mbɔɔn, itàkal taaŋ, itàkal mbwaar myàmɛnà anki, un'pöb a ngwal kàkäl mbɔɔn, lalan mpa kàkäl bi anà làkyän muwà mɔ̈ɔ̈.

An'taaŋ mbɔɔn baar badi anki. Apan, Pɔl kàmbarà uboboo a ba, waa kàtɛn naa: « Ɔɔ asam amɛ, yàlàkal ubwaŋ naa bɛ làwem lwɛŋ amɛ mukɔɔn ambarà u Krɛt, ntɔn mukɔɔn ayàman nkweel ayi anà bwà alà.
Wɛɛ apanà, mɛ amàlalɔm musà un'kanà, ntɔn akà mbuur mwɛy uboo a bɛ ukwà anki, wɛɛ an'swà mpɛl ikyà bwà.
U mpib aŋàbà, un'kyeey mwɛy wà Nzam in'wà mɛ uboo ande anà in'fàsyääl mɛ ayàmɛnà akà mɛ,
waa kan'kyään naa: "Pɔl, twon an'man bɔɔmà! Yubwaŋ naa ngye akàsà un'lɔɔn u mii a Sɛzar, waa Nzam kàmapà sye mɔ̈ɔ̈ a atɔŋ angye abà musabà anà ngye."
Lalan, asam amɛ, làkäl ngwal, ntɔn mɛ in'we anà làkwikilà amu Nzam naa ya iyàkal balàbal asànaa kan'kyään nde.
Wɛɛ bi ikàtsüüŋ kà un'kɔɔl a isaŋ mwɛy. »
U mpib yà kwem aŋinà, un'pöb kisyen u Adriyatik. Uboboo a mpib, baar a isal a an'swà bàmɛn asànaa bi kàkäl tsütsü a nkankyel.
Apan ba bàsii indübà a an'dà a lwaŋ, ba bàmɛn mɛtre an'kwem an'tär aŋinsambwaar. U kikwɛl, ba bàfàtɔɔm lwaŋ, waa bàmɛn mɛtre an'kwem mɔ̈ɔ̈l aŋinaan.
Ba bàmɛn bɔɔmà naa bi ikyer akàböl udu a in'kul, lalan bàtɔɔm ba an'löŋ an'nà kà an'dà ungö anà bàkäl musyäär naa taaŋ làyaanà.
Wɛɛ, baar a isal a an'swà bàleŋà mbwo yanswà mutiin an'swà, ba bàtɔ̈ɔ̈l itiir un'sɛŋ kà an'dà anà bàkür naa ba bàkàbäm an'löŋ kusà a an'swà.
Pɔl kàtɛn a kaptɛn anà aŋità naa: « Isàkal naa baar bà bàkal anki uboo a an'swà, bɛ, bɛ làwà anki mɔ̈ɔ̈. »
Lalan aŋità bàtsül ba in'siŋ a itiir a un'sɛŋ, waa bàtyeey kya.
Kusà a mwäänà mubalà, Pɔl kàlɔ̈m akà baar banswà mudyà isaa anà mutɛn naa: « Ŋàbà ilä kyàkwem aŋinà làdilà bɛ, ukɔɔn adyà anà mpa làkwen bɛ musà akà undiir mwɛy u mun.
Lalan mɛ amàlalɔm mudyà ndam a isaa ntɔn bya byà ndöŋ ntɔn bɛ làwü mɔ̈ɔ̈. Akà làtswe a un'tswe a umwɛy uboo a bɛ làyàkyà anki bwà. »
Ungö mutɛn abwɛy, nde kàwɛl làmpà, kàkömà Nzam u mii a baar banswà, kàtsül la, waa kàsɛmà mudyà.
Apan, ba banswà bàwɛl ngwal, waa bàdi sye.
Bi banswà uboo a an'swà kàkäl baar nkam yweel a an'kwem nsambwaar aŋisyaam.
Ungö muyuur a isaa, ba bàtyeey buur a an'swà mutɔɔm blɛ kà an'dà.
Miinà
Mpal làyaanà taaŋ, baar a isal a an'swà bàmɛn anki nkankyel, wɛɛ ma màkäl ansɛŋ a an'dà anà un'soo, ba bàbön musiinà an'swà kwo, kya mbwo yàlàkal.
Apan ba bàtsuuŋ an'löŋ, bàwɛy ma uboo a an'dà, ba bàtsuuŋ sye in'siŋ myàfàkwaar an'swà. Ungö ba bàmbaar ipfɛy kusà a an'swà ntɔn un'pöb kasyen kà un'kɔɔl a an'dà, kya mbwo yàlàkal.

Wɛɛ ba bàkàböl kà ansɛŋ màkäl uboboo a indek myeel, ba bàsiinà an'swà u nkankyel, usà bàteen kà ansɛŋ anà bàsàkwo anki mubar, wɛɛ akà ngö a an'swà, ibɔ a an'dà byàkäl mupay ya a ngwal.
Apan, aŋità bàwɛl an'kyän mudwa baar a bɔlokà ntɔn uman naa umwɛy uboo a ba utääb anà utiin.
Wɛɛ kaptɛn kàkwen mutswà Pɔl mɔ̈ɔ̈, waa katsüŋ musyääl an'kyän aba. Nde kàswɛŋ baar bàyöb utääb mukal baar atàtwɛb mutɔɔmà kà an'dà anà musabà u nkankyel.
Bumwɛy bàlàsabà udu a an'bää anà udu a ikaam a an'swà. Undiiràwun, ba banswà bàtöl nkankyel anà mɔ̈ɔ̈.
